notes.title: Peachleaf Valley is an upcoming farming-sim inspired otome visual novel
notes.content:
Peachleaf Valley, currently having a big success on Kickstarter is a visual novel inspired by farming life sims like Harvest Moon and Stardew Valley.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2021/06/peachleaf-valley-is-an-upcoming-farming-sim-inspired-otome-visual-novel
